items.title: Putter Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 27, 2024
items.q: His collaborations on stage and in the studios included work with Thelonious Monk, Art Blakey, The Beach Boys, and Sonny & Cher.

ctx.x: What was your record collection like when you were — oh I don’t know, 15 or 16?

Bud Powell, Charlie Parker, Bud Powell, Charlie Parker, Art Blakey, Gerry Mulligan, Chet Baker, Art Tatum was a huge — I just listened to Art Tatum all the time. And all those guys. And then a few years later Billie Holiday came in the thing and I still listen to music — when I find something I need I listen to it obsessively. Mostly I don’t listen to music at all anymore but that’s — the record with Bud Powell and Bird and Jazz at Massey Hall — even though it’s a big mess, Charlie Parker’s — Jesus — Charlie…
Yes I know there was some kind of historical reference there. Would there be any pop music of the day in your record collection? Let’s say early rock & roll or, you know, later on Motown etcetera?
